# Mpx 开发指南

本 Skill 提供了 Mpx 框架的基础开发指南索引。Mpx 是一款致力于提高小程序开发体验和开发效率的增强型小程序框架。

## 1. Mpx 框架简介
Mpx 是对小程序原生开发标准的补强和扩充，支持单文件开发、数据响应、增强模板语法等。
- **详细介绍**: [intro.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/intro.md)

## 2. 快速开始
- **项目创建与运行**: [start.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/start.md)
- **项目结构**: [project-structure.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/project-structure.md)
- **IDE 配置**: [ide.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/ide.md)

## 3. 核心概念
Mpx 的核心由 App、Page 和 Component 组成。
- **App (应用实例)**: [app.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/app.md) - 介绍 App 的生命周期、全局配置等。
- **Page (页面)**: [page.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/page.md) - 介绍页面的创建、生命周期、配置等。
- **Component (组件)**: [component.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/component.md) - 介绍自定义组件的创建、属性、生命周期、插槽等。

## 4. 基础语法
Mpx 支持类似 Vue 的开发体验。
- **单文件组件 (SFC)**: [single-file.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/single-file.md)
- **模板语法**: [template.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/template.md)
- **数据绑定**: [data-binding.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/data-binding.md)
- **列表渲染 (wx:for)**: [list-render.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/list-render.md)
- **条件渲染 (wx:if)**: [conditional-render.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/conditional-render.md)
- **事件处理**: [event.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/event.md)
- **样式处理 (CSS)**: [css.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/css.md)
- **Class 与 Style 绑定**: [class-style-binding.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/class-style-binding.md)

## 5. 响应式系统
Mpx 提供了强大的数据响应能力。

<template>
  <view class="recommend-list">
    <view wx:for="{{items}}" wx:key="id" bindtap="select(item.id)">{{item.title}}</view>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { createComponent } from '@mpxjs/core'

createComponent({
  properties: {
    articleId: String,
    items: { type: Array, value: () => [] }
  },
  methods: {
    select (articleId) {
      this.triggerEvent('select', { articleId })
    }
  }
})
</script>

<script>
import { createApp } from '@mpxjs/core'
import { createPinia } from '@mpxjs/pinia'

const pinia = createPinia()

createApp({
  onAppInit () {
    return { pinia }
  },
  onSSRAppCreated ({ app, router, context }) {
    router.push(context.url)
    context.state = pinia.state.value
    return app
  }
})
</script>

<script type="application/json">
{
  "pages": ["pages/article/detail"],
  "packages": [
    {"root": "packageRecommend", "pages": []}
  ]
}
</script>

<template>
  <view class="article-page">
    <text class="nonce">{{renderNonce}}</text>
    <text class="title">{{article.title}}</text>
    <rich-text nodes="{{article.content}}" />
    <button bindtap="toggleFavorite">{{favorite ? '已收藏' : '收藏'}}</button>
    <view wx:if="{{isBrowser}}" class="share-toolbar">复制链接</view>
    <recommend-list article-id="{{articleId}}" items="{{recommendations}}" bindselect="openArticle" />
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import mpx, { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'
import { useArticleStore } from '../../stores/article'

createPage({
  data: {
    articleId: '',
    renderNonce: Math.random(),
    isBrowser: typeof window !== 'undefined',
    favorite: false
  },
  computed: {
    article () { return useArticleStore(this.$pinia).article || {} },
    recommendations () { return useArticleStore(this.$pinia).recommendations }
  },
  onLoad (query) {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') this.loadArticle(query.id)
  },
  serverPrefetch () {
    this.loadArticle(this.$route.query.id, this.$ssrContext)
  },
  methods: {
    loadArticle (articleId, requestContext) {
      this.articleId = articleId
      return useArticleStore(this.$pinia).loadArticle(articleId, requestContext)
    },
    toggleFavorite () { this.favorite = !this.favorite },
    openArticle (event) {
      mpx.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/article/detail?id=${event.detail.articleId}` })
    }
  }
})
</script>

<script type="application/json">
{
  "usingComponents": {
    "recommend-list": "../../packageRecommend/components/recommend-list?root=packageRecommend"
  },
  "componentPlaceholder": {
    "recommend-list": "view"
  }
}
</script>
